issues.description: ImagePreview example has unreachable code after return statement
issues.detail: The function returns the URL form, then has a commented-out data-URI alternative below it. A reader copy-pasting gets only the URL form and the alternative is dead code. Split into two separate functions or move the alternative into a comment block above the return. Docs are read literally.

issues.description: Example uses gratuitously clever `next(n for n in pipeline.nodes)` instead of indexing
issues.detail: The basic-usage example retrieves a node via `next(n for n in pipeline.nodes)` where `pipeline.nodes[0]` or a named lookup would do. The generator expression suggests filtering that isn't happening, teaches obscure idiom by example, and becomes cargo cult when copy-pasted into user code.

issues.description: Closure-capture 'data context' example contradicts its framing and omits the binding hazard
issues.detail: The section claims to demonstrate data context but closes over a hardcoded literal at pipeline-construction time, not actual catalog data. It also omits warning that mutation of the captured object after pipeline construction will silently alter preview output — a classic late-binding footgun. Either show real catalog loading or drop the section.

issues.description: Mermaid `meta` dict conflates two unrelated concerns under one name
issues.detail: The meta dict mixes Mermaid library config (securityLevel, flowchart, themeVariables) with Kedro-Viz-specific textStyle CSS — different data consumed by different renderers. The doc later admits meta has 'two purposes,' which is one too many. Readers will be surprised when textStyle doesn't appear in Mermaid's own schema.

issues.description: preview_fn contract is unspecified and best-practices punts to defensive try-except
issues.detail: Docs introduce preview_fn as 'a callable that returns a preview payload' but never specify purity, side-effect rules, idempotency, or failure semantics. The 'wrap in try-except if needed' guidance substitutes exception swallowing for a stated failure mode rather than defining what preview() returns or propagates on error.

issues.description: PR checklist leaves RELEASE.md note unchecked for a user-facing feature
issues.detail: Self-reported in the PR checklist: the RELEASE.md box is unchecked. A docs-only patch can skip tests, but a user-facing feature getting documented should land with a one-line RELEASE entry pointing users at the new section. State it or check it.

synthesis.summary: Documentation patch adding a substantial new section to nodes.md covering the experimental preview_fn feature. The prose is broadly clear but the example code carries small, propagating sloppiness: unreachable code after a return in ImagePreview, gratuitously clever `next(...)` retrieval where indexing would do, and a closure-capture example that contradicts its own 'data context' framing. The Mermaid meta dict conflates renderer config with descriptive metadata under one name. The preview_fn contract itself is left unspecified, with best-practices punting to defensive try-except. Fix the examples so they run as written and tighten the contract before landing.
